text: 联创光电：因公司及伍锐先生涉嫌未按规定披露非经营性资金往来等违法行为，中国证监会决定对公司及伍锐先生立案
text_en: Lianchuang Optoelectronics: For suspected failure to disclose non-operating fund transactions as required and other illegal acts involving the company and Mr. Wu Rui, the CSRC decided to file a case against the company and Mr. Wu Rui
